goals: Audit historical BTC weekly trend entry and exit as independent-episode-like units 2011-2026

Archive all raw public Coin Metrics daily PriceUSD API responses and normalized daily records for the eight studied assets privately in R2 with SHA-256/readback so reproducible data persist independently of future API availability
Audit released-data availability and vintage requirements before any macro liquidity historical joins
entryDefinition: For consecutive confirmed Sunday BTC trend booleans from frozen v8.6, a transition EVENT occurs only when it switches. First eligible week is left censored. Fixed 2026-10-11 final Sunday; no future.
outcomeDefinition: After entry, count weeks until next opposite confirmed weekly transition; at each entry report BTC close-to-close forward 4/13/26/52wk returns, median worst daily-close drawdown unchanged from v8.6, or RIGHT_CENSORED. Trend persistence until 4w and 13w means next phase change >4 or >13 Sundays, not a profit win rate.
risk: Separate unconfirmed trend exits from confirmed trend entries; classify only price trend, not bull/bear macro stage. 2011-2012 has very different market structure and liquidity.
broadening: For trend-entry events, examine fixed ETH/BTC>0 and >=4/6 alt outperforming BTC 30d weekly flag from v8.6; only when complete valid eight-asset universe. If breadth UNKNOWN at any week within window, mark outcome DATA_CENSORED. Evaluate first 13w BROAD versus first 13w LOST_TREND, same date cannot both, censor incomplete.
split: 2011-2012,2013-2016,2017-2019,2020-2023,2024-2026. Report cases, medians, censorship, do not extrapolate across early market eras.
sensitivity: Greedy every 13wk retained trend-entry events anchored to earliest event, show as check, still dependence and anchor bias.

sourceArchive.rawArchive: Each fetched JSON response page as private R2 original bytes plus normalized date/PriceUSD array
sourceArchive.validation: Positive finite prices; duplicate dates prohibited; exact observed count, first/last, and no gaps compared with frozen v8.6 source coverage; daily BTC Sunday PriceUSD equals every frozen v8.6 BTC weekly price to 1e-5 absolute; alt daily prices and fixed breadth count compare to all frozen weeks where eligible. Fail closed on mismatch, do not silently update v8.6.
sourceArchive.sourceRawContentHash: SHA-256 of bytes retrieved at execution; pinned fetch date; CoinMetrics may revise historic fixing and historical source vintage remains unknown.
sourceArchive.storage: Cloudflare R2 under research/btci/v8.7/runs/<id>/source/{asset}/{raw_page.json,normalized_daily.json}, immutable by unique run prefix. A manifest with object hashes, SHA-256 readback and external provenance.
sourceArchive.note: Original Binance Spot monthly ZIPs, Binance futures 5m archives already on their original source/earlier R2, external macro vintages not automatically mirrored in this v8.7; distinguish all clearly.

macroReadiness.WALCL: Federal Reserve H4.1 weekly assets, Wed observation, Thurs release
macroReadiness.WLRRAL: Wednesday consolidated Fed reverse repo in H.4.1; alternatively ON RRP DAILY RRPONTSYD must observe separate release/time and units
macroReadiness.NFCI: Chicago Fed release requires publication-time PIT mapping
macroReadiness.required: FRED API key for fred/series/observations with vintage_dates/realtime_start; no fabricated values without authorized API or timestamped release
macroReadiness.validation: Only use indicators known as-of Monday UTC weekly decision and show missingness/delays; later week-outcome windows cannot contaminate features.

noHindsight: Exploratory retrospective model created after observing history; zero point-in-time claims for CoinMetrics retro revisions, no calibrated prediction or out-of-sample claim
protection: No changes to Master, Futures, Spot, NAV, P&L, reserve, capital, trading permissions or detector runtime
halt: Missing price / integrity fail => no PASS and no invented result. Storage writeback must have reread SHA.
